text: Of the Philippine education projects with public procurement plans, only the Teacher Effectiveness and Competencies Enhancement Project (TEACEP, P164765; Department of Education; IBRD loan 9481-PH) has tablet packages; none lists digital learning content as such. Amounts are estimates in US$ from the STEP tables.
TEACEP, latest plan (2026-10-14, revision of a plan first approved 2024-04-18):

- TEACEP-GO-3-RFB, supply and delivery of 16,600 tablets (component 'providing adequate materials for effective teaching and learning'): Request for Bids, Open - National, single-stage one-envelope, prior review; estimated US$5,629,363.65; status Signed, with a planned completion date of 2027-04-05 (actual contract amount not yet recorded).
- TEACEP-GO-1-RFQ and its re-launch -R1, IT equipment (36 laptops): Request for Quotations; estimated US$33,752.24; both Canceled.

- Other IT packages: GO-5-RFQ IT equipment, US$265,000, and GO-2-RFQ digital duplicators, US$222,000, both Pending Implementation; GO-4-RFQ 14,160 solar-powered radios, US$297,353, plus radio airtime contracts (US$100,000 each for Region IX, Region XII and BARMM). These support distance teaching by radio, not digital content.

Change across versions: the tablet package was 45,000 tablets estimated at US$9,425,494 in the plans up to 2025-04-14 (p. 3), and 16,600 tablets at US$5,629,363.65 from the 2025-05-21 plan onward (p. 3).

Other projects: the JSDF 'No Bangsamoro Child Left Behind' plan (P176749) buys laptops and other IT equipment for administration (e.g. about US$10,400, p. 4), not tablets or learning content; the Infrastructure for Safer and Resilient Schools plan has no such items.
Coverage: the latest plan of each education project and all 12 TEACEP versions were checked for tablets.

right_sources: Reads the Philippine education projects' procurement plans and finds the TEACEP tablet package.
grounded: Description, method and estimated cost match the plan, with the plan's date cited; the estimate is not presented as a contract amount.
complete: Gives description, method and estimated cost for each matching package and says that no plan lists digital content.
scoped: States which plans were checked; noting the 45,000-to-16,600 change between versions is a plus.

notes: TEACEP is active, so new plan versions may change statuses.
